title: WOLF / Bearing Component Study
authorship: Original Mechanism Studio music composition and pure code synthesis, reused as a music bed and freshly rendered with source-bound bearing editorial effects. No third-party samples, voice services or recordings.
musicalFeel: The established gentle pads, warm bass and felt keys, with a quieter component close-up and continuous reassembly. No drum bed, narration or label dings.
timing: One seekable PCM clock: seconds = beat * 60 / 112. Bearing cues derive from the actual motion-event windows and retained source occurrence IDs.

compositionReuse.method: Only explicitly shaped music-role events are reused. Original motor effects and PCM are excluded; this complete bearing WAV is rendered anew.

mix.effects: Smooth filtered-air movement textures and two gentle editorial return seats. No recorded or simulated bearing acoustics.

automation.method: Continuous smoothstep gain, with matching beginning and ending gain.

effects.clock: Baked into the same PCM buffer. No wall-clock timers or scene restarts.
effects.repetitionPolicy: One continuous sweep per separation/return of the four small-part batches. No sixty-six separate clicks or inferred small-part functions.

events.gainReference: Synthesized event mono sample peak before equal-power center panning.
